description: This Java source file defines the ResponderService class, which is an Android background service responsible for handling incoming messages, generating responses via an ElizaResponder instance, managing chat history, and displaying notifications with reply actions in an Android Wearable app.

classes.name: ResponderService
classes.description: An Android Service that responds to incoming messages from a wearable device, maintains chat history, and displays notifications with reply actions. It utilizes ElizaResponder to generate responses and communicates via local broadcasts and system notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up the ElizaResponder, and processes any incoming intents.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used for this service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents for replying to messages or retrieving chat history.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification containing the latest response and an action button for replying.

methods.name: processIncoming
methods.description: Processes received text, generates a response, updates chat history, and updates the notification.

methods.name: broadcastMessage
methods.description: Sends a broadcast with the current chat message or conversation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels notifications when the service is destroyed.
